hook.say: This morning I covered the backdoored Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace, with 5,000 developer systems impacted. I went back in to check the numbers around it.

findings.label: EXPOSURE
findings.headline: The bad version stayed live for about 11 hours
findings.detail: Cursor says it ran from 2:27 am to 1:35 pm PT on October 29.
findings.evidence: distributed through Cursor's extension marketplace for approximately 11 hours on October 29
findings.say: First, the bad version was live for about 11 hours, from 2:27 am to 1:35 pm Pacific, according to Cursor.

findings.label: PAYLOAD
findings.headline: The malicious loader is only 66 lines of code
findings.detail: It was inserted before the legitimate extension code in the main bundle.
findings.evidence: its main JavaScript bundle contains a malicious 66-line loader inserted before the legitimate extension code
findings.say: Second, the malicious loader is only 66 lines, pasted in front of the real extension code. Small change, big access.

findings.label: PATTERN
findings.headline: Third attack using the Claude name in one week
findings.detail: Earlier ones: fake download pages and fake apps with signed installers.
findings.evidence: This is the third time in a week that attackers have used the Claude name
findings.say: Third, this was the third time in a week that attackers used the Claude name, after fake download pages and fake apps.

take.headline: Auto-update is a trust decision.
take.say: My take: Auto-update is a trust decision. Measure which extensions your team runs and who approves them, before an attacker does it for you.

caption:
This morning: a backdoored Claude Code extension hit the Cursor Marketplace, with up to 5,000 developer systems impacted.

Three new data points: the bad version was live for about 11 hours. The malicious loader is just 66 lines. It was the third attack using the Claude name in a week.

My take: auto-update is a trust decision. Measure what your team installs and who approves it.

Comment CLAUDE and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.
